# openwrt_sys_net_conntrack (Data Source)

Retrieves the connection tracking table from OpenWrt.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `entries` (List of Object) List of tracked connections. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--entries))
- `id` (String) Internal ID.

<a id="nestedatt--entries"></a>
### Nested Schema for `entries`

Read-Only:

- `dest_ip` (String)
- `dest_port` (Number)

- `src_port` (Number)
- `state` (String)
